The headphone arch curves over and touches the sphere; both ear cups are physically seated against the sphere's left and right sides, with contact shading and no floating parts. The main purple sphere has exactly two bright white rounded capsule eyes, slightly tilted in the same diagonal direction, facing forward. In the front-left foreground place one smaller smooth soft-blue round Dots with the same two white inclined capsule eyes. In the front-right foreground place one smaller smooth soft-pink round Dots, wearing thin black circular glasses that sit flush against its curved face; inside the glasses show two matching white inclined capsule eyes. At the upper-right, place one smallest sunny-yellow spherical Dots lightly hovering as a playful accent, with two small white inclined capsule eyes. Exactly four characters total.

Distinct foreground/middle/background planes, natural overlap and contact, clearly visible faces, complete round silhouettes. Keep the central purple sphere clearly purple and largest; blue remains a small companion. Keep all four characters together occupying about 85 percent of the square canvas height, with about 5 percent clear transparent safety margin around the full group.
Identity: this design follows the R01 Dots family visual, where the purple orb and companions use simple white slanted capsule eyes. Do not use Grok's current-v2 colors or family arrangement.

Lighting/mood: bright soft warm studio key light, balanced fill, subtle highlights on the satin surfaces, gentle contact shading only where accessories and characters touch.
Constraints: exactly four and only four Dots characters: one dominant purple spherical headphone Dot, one small blue sphere lower-left, one pink sphere with directly seated black round eyeglasses lower-right, and one tiny yellow sphere upper-right.
